label: SDRplay (RSP1A / RSPdx / RSPduo)
notes: 2 MS/s with 5 MHz IF filter is the canonical SDRplay 'general listening' setup — wide enough to scan a band, narrow enough to keep a strong adjacent carrier from desensing the front end. The 200 kHz default that ships with SoapySDRPlay would brick-wall the spectrum at ±100 kHz.
